description: ESLint plugin for Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK security — follows tool arguments into shells, file paths, URLs, SQL and eval; catches credential leaks, untrusted text in model-facing descriptions and prompts, unhardened HTTP transports, shared statele
author: Ofri Peretz

tool_signatures.name: JSON
tool_signatures.description: Execute JSON

tool_signatures.name: URL
tool_signatures.description: Execute URL

tool_signatures.name: __dirname
tool_signatures.description: Execute __dirname

tool_signatures.name: __filename
tool_signatures.description: Execute __filename

tool_signatures.name: no-code-injection-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool argument reaching eval, new Function or a vm context as code

tool_signatures.name: no-command-injection-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool argument choosing the command a child_process call runs

tool_signatures.name: no-credential-leak-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool returning the server

tool_signatures.name: no-duplicate-tool-name
tool_signatures.description: Disallow registering or listing two MCP tools with the same name on one server

tool_signatures.name: no-path-traversal-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool argument choosing the file an fs call reads, writes or deletes without a containment check

tool_signatures.name: no-predictable-session-id
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP sessionIdGenerator that returns a counter, a timestamp, Math.random() or a constant

tool_signatures.name: no-shared-stateless-transport
tool_signatures.description: Disallow sharing one stateless Streamable HTTP transport or one MCP server across requests

tool_signatures.name: no-sql-injection-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool argument reaching the text of a SQL query instead of its parameters

tool_signatures.name: no-ssrf-in-tool
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP tool argument choosing the host an outbound HTTP request is sent to

tool_signatures.name: no-tool-description-injection
tool_signatures.description: Disallow MCP tool, prompt and resource descriptions built from text a client, a remote service or a file controls

tool_signatures.name: no-untrusted-stdio-command
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP client spawning a stdio server whose command comes from a tool argument, a network response or a project config file

tool_signatures.name: no-untrusted-tool-metadata-in-prompt
tool_signatures.description: Disallow an MCP client writing a server

tool_signatures.name: no-unvalidated-tool-args
tool_signatures.description: Disallow a tool handler reading an argument its declared input schema does not include

tool_signatures.name: require-http-transport-hardening
tool_signatures.description: Require an MCP HTTP server transport to validate the Host header and a network-reachable MCP server to authenticate its callers

tool_signatures.name: require-tool-input-schema
tool_signatures.description: Require an input schema when an MCP tool handler reads arguments
